scope: Public aggregate and endpoint benchmark screen for light-duty and heavy-duty HRS operating-range face validity
purpose: Check whether the locked simulator's nominal pressure and flow envelope is visibly compatible with reported public HRS operating points without treating aggregate or figure-only evidence as synchronized full-loop validation.

source_manifest.rights_and_trace_boundary: Only source-reported endpoint, aggregate or figure-level values are used. No public source supplies a rights-cleared common-time-base station-to-vehicle pressure-temperature-mass-flow archive in this screen.

locked_model_reference.interpretation: These are locked reference-scenario values, not parameters fitted to the public sources in this screen.

source_metrics.use_boundary: face-validity context and acquisition lead; not a time-series holdout

reported_case.protocol: SAE J2601-5 MCF-HF-G H70 FM300 T40

source_metrics.use_boundary: high-flow heavy-duty context and acquisition lead; outside the locked light-duty default flow envelope and not a raw holdout
station-scale operating context only; no event-level synchronous trace

derived_checks.meaning: The default 70 MPa vehicle target lies between the two public CIP endpoint cases.
derived_checks.claim_limit: Endpoint compatibility only; it does not validate pressure trajectory, temperature or controller timing.

derived_checks.meaning: The default dispenser flow ceiling is above the reported 70 MPa CIP peak.
derived_checks.claim_limit: A peak value is not a synchronized trace and does not validate flow regulation or measurement uncertainty.

derived_checks.meaning: The reference compressor ceiling is close to the reported CIP peak, so the compressor/dispenser distinction must remain explicit in interpretation.
derived_checks.claim_limit: The public source does not expose the compressor state or station-side flow split for that case.

derived_checks.meaning: The locked reference scenario does not claim to reproduce the NREL heavy-duty high-flow case.
derived_checks.claim_limit: This is an explicit scope boundary, not a model failure against a raw holdout. A separate heavy-duty configuration and raw synchronized validation set are required.

derived_checks.formula: 350/700 bar public service context includes the 70 MPa reference target
derived_checks.meaning: The public Mountain View station report is consistent with the reference station's 35/70 MPa service context.
derived_checks.claim_limit: Aggregate station throughput and fill-time statistics do not validate the simulated transient.

limitations: No synchronized public station/controller/vehicle row-level archive with explicit reuse rights was available in the source manifest.
The screen does not fit or change simulator parameters.
Endpoint and aggregate compatibility cannot establish physics validity, safety distance, operator effectiveness or SAGA benefit.
Heavy-duty high-flow behaviour remains outside the default reference configuration and requires a separately frozen validation plan.
next_action: Use this screen as a transparent operating-range appendix, then obtain a rights-cleared synchronized full-loop archive and score it under the already frozen pre-access protocol.
